Las fichas no tienen valor en dinero: no: Chips have no money value: they're not bought, sold or exchanged for cash or coins. They're earned with missions and achievements, and used for tables with an entry fee, tournaments and the shop. At tables with an entry fee and in tournaments, Reviro keeps 10% of the chips in the pot; the remaining 90% is the prize shown on screen.
Las monedas se ganan jugando o se compra: Coins are earned by playing or bought with Mercado Pago. They only serve as another way to pay in the shop (characters, jerseys, card backs and cloths). They're not exchanged for chips or money, can't be transferred to other accounts and aren't refunded, unless the purchase wasn't credited.
Abandonar una partida online cuenta como: Quitting an online game counts as a defeat. At tables with an entry fee, if someone leaves in the first 30 seconds, the game is cancelled and all entries are refunded. After that, if someone disconnects, the game waits 60 seconds: if they don't come back, they lose their entry, which is split among the rivals, and their partner gets theirs back.
Si alguien se registra con tu link de in: If someone signs up with your invitation link and plays their first online game against another person, you earn {0} chips, and the invited person starts with {1} gift chips as soon as they sign up. The administrator can raise the prize for those who invite more people. Referral chips are like the rest: they have no money value. Each person counts only once and only if it's a new account. Creating fake or duplicate accounts to collect referrals is forbidden: collected chips are removed and the account may be suspended.
No se permiten trampas, cuentas múltiple: Cheating, multiple accounts to gain an advantage and insults are not allowed. The administrator can suspend accounts and correct balances in case of fraud or errors, and those actions are logged.
